surfaces: governed list surfaces accepting --cursor (per-surface wiring lands with bd-7lvbg.3)

trigger.description: An ee.cursor.v1 continuation cursor fails validation (ADR 0063 §3): the BLAKE3 MAC does not verify (tampering or a different workspace key), the paramsHash does not match the new invocation's normalized parameters, the embedded dbGeneration is from the future, or the token is a legacy/garbage format (including pre-migration bespoke audit-timeline cursors). The codec and degraded contract ship with bd-7lvbg.2; the per-surface --cursor resume flag lands with bd-7lvbg.3.
